prediction: The implementation of 'containsIgnoreCase' will be found to use standard 'toUpperCase()' or 'toLowerCase()' without specifying 'Locale.ROOT' or 'Locale.ENGLISH', leading to locale-dependent behavior that breaks the expected case-insensitive logic.

The failure in a locale-independence test confirms that the method's internal algorithm for case-insensitive comparison is flawed due to this locale sensitivity.
reasoning_summary: The defect is in the computational procedure of the 'containsIgnoreCase' method. This is not a missing check (Checking), a wrong value (Assignment), or a design-level capability gap (Function/Class/Object), but a flaw in the implementation of the comparison algorithm itself.
